title: Toddler in Sunsuit with Toy Pail, Backyard - Vintage 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vertical snapshot capturing a barefoot toddler wearing a light-colored summer romper or sunsuit standing in a dappled-sunlight yard. The child looks over their shoulder toward the camera while carrying a small decorated pail or watering can. Dense bushes and the clapboard siding of a house frame the background. The back features photo album mounting residue and a printed processing number '690'.
